title: Hunt Pattern
rules_text: Hold Embermaw's front, then leave the marked breath cone.

instant_beats.title: Raking Claw
instant_beats.rules_text: Target: Tank. Deal 4 damage. Movement does not evade this hit. An unheld Guarded Front suffers +3.

instant_beats.title: Ash Trail
instant_beats.rules_text: The struck front arc becomes Scorched.

incoming_beats.title: Brood Call
incoming_beats.rules_text: Whelps emerge at the marked edge hexes.

incoming_beats.title: Close the Lanes
incoming_beats.rules_text: Resolve the cone before Whelps close routes.
